title: Home page never mentions groups, pools or playing with friends
what_happened: I read the whole home page. It says free to play and no stakes, and talks about a Prophet Rating, but says nothing about private groups, pools, leagues or inviting friends.
expected: A line on the home page saying whether I can run a private group for friends, and how

title: The weekly slate is empty and the week label is a dash in week 6 of the season
what_happened: Weekly Pick em and Survivor shows The slate with nothing under it, the week selector between the arrows shows only a dash, and the survivor box says Week 6. I cannot see a single game my friends would be picking.
expected: This week's games listed under The slate, with the week number in the selector

title: Sign in to join looks disabled
what_happened: The Sign in to join button in the survivor box is pale lilac with white text, like a greyed-out button, so I was not sure it could be pressed.
expected: A button that looks pressable, with readable contrast

title: Sign in to join does nothing when pressed
what_happened: I pressed Sign in to join in the survivor box. Nothing opened. The page now says No NFL games scheduled yet, the schedule fills in as it is released, in mid-October while the same box says Week 6.
expected: Pressing it opens the sign-in or sign-up, and the slate shows this week's scheduled games

title: Sign-up wall never says whether private groups exist
what_happened: I reached the sign-up wall. It asks for a Display Name, an Email and a Password, or Google, and nothing else: no line on what an account gives me, no word on private groups, pools or inviting friends, no link to terms. Nowhere before it did the site say whether I can run a group for my friends.
expected: Before or on the sign-up, a plain statement of whether I can make a private group and invite friends, and what joining involves for them

title: Sign-in box uses a different, plain typeface
what_happened: The sign-in and sign-up box appears in a plain serif typewriter-style font, unlike the rest of the site, which made it look like a different site had popped up.
expected: The same font and style as the rest of the site, so I trust the box asking for my password
